'''Emily Janse''' was [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] officer and the director of five mines in [[Reena Province]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She had a great deal of influence in the [[League of Tapani Freeworlds]] and the [[Great Council (Tapani Federation)|Great Council]] although not enough to prevent her [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from being hit by [[Freeworlds Territory]] tariffs.

She was secretly a member of the [[Mecrosa Order]] and joined [[The Chamber]] so she could meet its members.
